Problem Description
: DC1_CableTempSensor_XD100
Troubleshooting
: I checked your charger's outlet 1 and here is the graph of the resistance:
As you can see there seems to be something wrong either with the temperature sensor or the connections to the StateMonitor.
Please schedule a site visit and confirm the resistance from these points:
If the values are indeed above expected the temperature sensor is broken and needs to be replaced (whole cable). If the readings are correct from XD10 until the StateMonitor then please try and use a non-used connector that you can find in the StateMonitor and swap it. If it still doesn't work we might have a faulty StateMonitor (unlikely since DC2 is working but you never know).
I recommend you to replace components as you need. Please provide the evidence for the replacements.
For future reference, your case number is
0403039
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
